reviews.comment: Lectures were extremely unorganized but manageable. Tests always had 10-20 bonus points but were graded extremely harshly. Homework was not graded and practice exams were given each time with partial answer keys.

Maji is a professor who generally has good intentions but falls short in explaining the course material with his unorganized lectures. He explains things that are not trivial as if they are. His tests are so heavily weighted on few questions (30% of an exam on 3mcq) and he also posthumously changed how the final was graded which harmed students.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved Majji's teaching style and he put great trust in his students to shape their own learning experience. The class is hard but Majji is not, he explains concepts extremely well. My only complaint is he did not prepare us enough on linearization which became massively important in 321.

Majji is great. He goes fast in class, but if you speak up and ask questions he will make SURE you understand. He is always available outside of class to do a Zoom meeting or send you an email. He gives lots of material and practice quizzes for the exams so you have good study material. Does lots of practice examples to explain the process well.
